about_the_game:
Dash. Strike. Survive.

Bushido Kensei: The Last Warrior is a dash-driven samurai rogue-like where momentum is survival.

Stand still — you die.
Slow down — you fall.

Combat is built around constant movement, aggressive pressure, and precision timing. Chain dash attacks, slice through demon hordes, and push forward without hesitation.

This is fast, relentless melee combat.

No gimmicks. No distractions. Just mastery.

⚔ Dash-Driven Combat

  • Lightning-fast katana strikes

  • Momentum-based movement system

  • Dash attacks that cut through enemies

  • Precision dodge rolls

  • Aggressive, high-speed encounters

Every fight rewards relentless forward pressure.

🔥 Rogue-Like Progression

Each run is different.

Level up and choose powerful active abilities or game-changing passive upgrades to shape your build.

Adapt. Improve. Push further.

🗡 Rare & Legendary Gear

Defeat demon hordes and brutal bosses to unlock:

  • Rare weapons

  • Legendary equipment

  • Powerful stat enhancements

Your gear defines your playstyle.

👹 Brutal Boss Battles

Face towering demon warlords guarding powerful rewards.

Learn their patterns.
Exploit weaknesses.
Survive the encounter.

🛡 Permanent Upgrades

Struggling to push deeper?

Invest in permanent stat upgrades between runs to strengthen your warrior and improve your chances.

🚧 Early Access

Bushido Kensei is evolving.

Planned updates include:

  • New heroes

  • Additional enemies

  • Expanded maps

  • New modes

Your feedback helps shape the future of the game.

content_descriptors.notes: Minor blood FX with visiable weapon displays.
